summary: Frontend E2E testing of the refonded onboarding (narrative + Sens/Foi layer). Executed full flow twice with fresh magic-link accounts. Both Foi and Sens universes tested end-to-end incl. DB persistence check in /app/backend/zayado.db. All acceptance criteria pass; no JS errors during the flow (only unrelated 404/403 for pre-auth static assets).
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx is ~600 lines and mixes 8+ screens; consider splitting each screen into its own component for maintainability.
doSave sends both `ambiance` and `spirituality` (= form.ambiance) which are duplicated in user.settings; acceptable but redundant.
In finish(), wellnessApi.seedChristianHabits() is fire-and-forget without any user-visible feedback; expected per spec (best-effort) — verified it is NOT called for non-foi ambiance.
test_credentials: Magic-link on /login with fresh @example.com emails (ALLOW_GUEST_LOGIN=true exposes dev_link).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 users via full onboarding: onbtest+1785945399@example.com (ambiance=foi) and onbtest+sens1785945460@example.com (ambiance=sens). Both persisted with onboarding_completed=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full narrative onboarding validated: slides text (mentions 'copilote' + 'écosystème Zayado' + 'Tout part de votre pourquoi'), Vision step (ob-pourquoi, ob-projet, ob-objectif), IA loading + aha-continue, 3 ambiance cards (clarte/sens/foi), foi card shows verset + info link to https://thesustain.net/bible (target=_blank), synthèse shows 'Univers Foi', POST /api/onboarding=200, Mémoire IA screen, overlay closes to /. Persistence in sqlite users.settings confirmed: {ambiance:'foi', spirituality:'foi', why:'offrir une vie meilleure à ma famille', onboarding_completed:true, project_type:'TERRAIN'}. Non-regression Sens: ambiance/spirituality='sens', no seed-christian call fired.
